subject: technology

rubric.exceeds: Every claim, calculation, artifact, or performance choice is accurate and faithful to the stated criteria, with no notable errors.
rubric.meets: The work is accurate and faithful to the stated criteria, with at most one minor, self-correctable error.
rubric.developing: The work is mostly accurate but has one or more errors that affect the result or the intended effect.
rubric.beginning: The work has multiple accuracy or fidelity errors that prevent it from meeting the stated criteria.

rubric.exceeds: Every choice is backed by specific, cited evidence or clearly explained reasoning that a reader/viewer/listener can follow without help.
rubric.meets: Most choices are backed by evidence or reasoning, with only small gaps.
rubric.developing: Some choices are backed by evidence or reasoning, but several are asserted without support.
rubric.beginning: Choices are asserted with little or no supporting evidence or reasoning.

rubric.exceeds: Fully meets this dimension with independent transfer.
rubric.beginning: Does not yet meet this dimension.

rubric.exceeds: Fully meets this dimension with independent transfer.
rubric.beginning: Does not yet meet this dimension.

rubric.exceeds: There is clear evidence of testing, critique, or self-checking that produced a real, documented revision improving the work.
rubric.meets: There is evidence of at least one checking or revision step.
rubric.developing: There is little evidence of checking or revision beyond a first attempt.
rubric.beginning: There is no evidence the work was checked or revised at all.

prompts.prompt: Explain evidence assembly and documentation in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a diagram, model, score, data display, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of independent review and critique response.
Apply limitations and future work in a new realistic situation. Show the process or cite the evidence.
Analyse a plausible error, weak claim, unsafe choice, rights problem, or design flaw involving maintenance security and sunset planning; correct it and explain why.
Explain how presentation in a chosen private or public mode and pathways portfolio and transition relate — how one supports, constrains, contrasts with, or builds on the other.

Present the strongest evidence from the unit task: Defend the capstone in a chosen private or public mode with complete documentation, a response to independent review, and a maintenance and transition plan.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy or quality, and one next question.
Respond to one substantive critique of the capstone work: state the critique fairly, say what you changed or why you did not, and name the limitation that remains.

mastery_interpretation.secure: At least 85% with accurate independent application and adequate evidence and reasoning.
mastery_interpretation.developing: 70–84% or inconsistent explanation; assign targeted review and a fresh transfer check.
mastery_interpretation.not_yet: Below 70% or a missing prerequisite; reteach the smallest gap and reassess with new evidence.
mastery_interpretation.rule: A unit score is one evidence source, not the sole basis for long-term mastery.

scoring_judgment_guidance: Score with the rubric below, not a single fixed answer key — a technical project legitimately has more than one valid solution. Compare the submission against each rubric dimension using the "performance evidence" prompt in the linked assessment record for Capstone Review, Defense, and Transition, and record which level the student reached for each dimension along with one specific reason drawn from the actual submission.
remediation_plan: If the project stalls, step back to the smallest version of the task: rebuild just the part covering evidence assembly and documentation in isolation, using a worked example from this unit as a model, then re-attach it to the full project once that smaller piece works and you can explain why.
extension_plan: Once the core project is working, extend it to handle a new constraint or edge case related to independent review and critique response, or compare two different approaches to the same problem and explain the real tradeoff between them in your own words.
accommodation_note: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed.

safety_and_privacy.note: No real credentials, live external systems, or real personal data are used anywhere in this unit's materials.
